about: Verdicts of claude-opus-5-5 on source against tree for hse-hsg150 (system/rag/semcheck.py).

findings.problem: A line of the cover blurb is dropped, joining two sentences wrongly.
findings.evidence: source: "everyone involved in construction. It provides help and assistance on how to work safely on most tasks" / tree: "everyone involved tasks you will encounter"

findings.problem: The page footer is kept in the text.
The end of the last bullet of paragraph 514 is cut off from the paragraph and put into Figure 51's labels, losing the rescue duties from the provision.
findings.evidence: source: "communicate with anyone inside, raise the alarm in an emergency ... It is essential those outside the space know what to do" / tree: "communicate with anyone"

findings.problem: Body text of paragraph 514 is stored as the labels of Figure 51, though the figure has no printed labels.
findings.evidence: tree labels: "inside, raise the alarm in an emergency and take charge of rescue procedures if"

findings.problem: The subheading and the step headings are read as body text and joined to the end of the paragraph before them.
findings.evidence: source: "How is a risk assessment carried out?" / "Step 1: Look for the hazards" (headings) / tree: "...to be undertaken. How is a risk assessment carried out? Step 1: Look for the hazards" in para 582

findings.problem: Step 2 and Step 3 headings are appended to paragraphs 585 and 587 instead of heading the paragraphs that follow.
findings.evidence: tree: "identified in Section 3. Step 2: Decide who might be harmed and how"; "what has been agreed. Step 3: Evaluate the risks and decide on action"

findings.problem: The superscript footnote reference 7 is run into the text after the regulation year.
The end of the last bullet of paragraph 160 is cut off, losing that edge protection also applies to platforms used for storing materials.
findings.evidence: source: "on all working platforms and platforms used for storing materials." / tree: "on all working platforms"

findings.problem: The cut-off end of the bullet was put into the labels of Figure 11, though it is not printed in the photo.
findings.evidence: tree labels: "and platforms used for storing materials."

findings.problem: The smaller italic heading for MEWPs is a subheading under 'Mobile access equipment' but the tree makes it a sibling.
findings.evidence: source: "Mobile elevating work platforms (MEWPs)" under "Mobile access equipment" / tree: "Working at height > Mobile elevating work platforms (MEWPs)"

findings.problem: The italic subheading 'Suspended access cradles' sits under 'Suspended access equipment' on the page, but the tree makes it a sibling under 'Working at height'.
findings.evidence: source: "Suspended access equipment" > "Suspended access cradles" / tree: "Working at height > Suspended access cradles"

findings.problem: The italic subheading 'Selection' sits under 'Vehicles and plant' on the page, but the tree makes it a sibling under 'Site traffic and mobile plant'.
findings.evidence: source: "Vehicles and plant" > "Selection" / tree: "Site traffic and mobile plant > Selection"

findings.problem: The figure's printed key of 39 numbered asbestos locations is not in labels; only a summary of it is in the description.
findings.evidence: source: "7 Lagging on boiler, pipework, calorifier etc." / tree labels: "Health and safety in construction Index"

findings.problem: The labels hold words that are not printed in the figure.
findings.evidence: tree: "Health and safety in construction Index"
